translations.web: You shall make yourselves fringes on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover yourself.
translations.bsb: You are to make tassels on the four corners of the cloak you wear.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt make thee fringes upon the four quarters of thy vesture, wherewith thou coverest
translations.asv: Thou shalt make thee fringes upon the four borders of thy vesture, wherewith thou coverest thyself.
